div.span:
Solid teal = the query path. Dashed purple = the maintenance loop. Dashed red, two-headed = a conflict raised by the layer and written back by a person.
Both closing paths end at the same governed layer, which is why an answer and its provenance cannot drift apart. rajeevg.com rig; business flows anonymised. Evidence date: 31 August 2026.
